name: TrigScript
description: TypeScript kept inside the map. Ordinary TypeScript — files, imports, helpers, loops — runs when the script is applied and records one trigger per trigger() call: ordinary triggers that play on every version. Code inside program(() => { … }) runs in the game — variables, loops, functions, sleep — and is built into the map by the eudplib plugin when you save; a map with a program needs StarCraft: Remastered. Checked as you type against the map's own names, with a built-in simulator.
author: Jeany
